transcript: Don't ruin something good. Just because you are afraid, it will not last. Listen carefully. Sometimes peace feels unfamiliar because you got used to chaos. When someone finally treats you with kindness, your mind may begin searching for danger. When life becomes calm, your heart may start looking for a problem. Not because something is wrong, but because pain trains you to expect disappointment. So you push people away before they can leave. You question good moments before they can become memories. You destroy the blessing, then tell yourself you were right not to trust it. But listen to me. Do not punish today for what yesterday did to you. Not every calm is fake. Not every kind person is hiding a knife. Not every good thing is waiting to disappear. Sometimes life is not tricking you. Sometimes life is finally giving you what you prayed for. So when peace comes, do not run. Breathe. Receive it and let something good stay good. Follow for more old monk lessons.
